gates.description: Only ACTIVE gates. A `planned` gate describes a future role and should not appear on a screen that says what is happening right now.

entrada.description: What needs to exist for the gate to open.

entregavel.description: What the gate produces when it passes.

aprovacaoHumana.description: The decision is the user's — direct on click OR delegated by a policy they wrote themselves (see RN-071).

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
